test_greedy_sampling: test the gm.text.Greedy sampler by calling get_next_tokens with random logits and an RNG key
test_random_sampling: test the gm.text.RandomSampling sampler by calling get_next_tokens with random logits and an RNG key
test_topk_sampling: test the gm.text.TopkSampling sampler with k=3 by calling get_next_tokens on random logits
test_topp_sampling: test the gm.text.TopPSampling sampler with p=0.9 by calling get_next_tokens on random logits
test_top1_equals_greedy: test that TopkSampling with k=1 produces identical tokens to the Greedy sampler
